title: Rebind deliver state after a PR head change
body:
Outcome: krn deliver rebinds or names the stale saved state when the PR head changed after an earlier stopped run, instead of refusing with "record/PR head mismatch".
Evidence: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/session-continuity/predecessor-retire/ (PR #159). deliver-2.out exit 71 after a new head 1219d03; the saved .krn/runs/deliver/<key>/state.json still held 7208c89 and had to be deleted by hand.
